[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 4-5 [[Granite Slab]]s | render = [[Image:Scorched Lodestone.jpg|100px]] }} ==Acquisition== * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Kourna]] *** [[Droughtling]] *** [[Stone Shard Crag]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Sentient Lodestone#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Arkjok Ward]]==== Enter from [[Command Post]]. 4 groups of 2 can be found along the northern wall, with the 4th group being a bit out of sight just south of the 3rd one. If you need the bounty, there is a resurrection shrine available, but it is a more difficult fight to reach it for the 8 point lightbringer reward. ====[[Barbarous Shore]]==== Start from [[Camp Hojanu]]. There are 9 groups if you stay near the western wall. The run takes about 10 mins, and there is a bounty available. Be aware of the groups of [[Heket]]s and [[Plant]]s found along the way. ====[[Dejarin Estate]]==== Start from [[Pogahn Passage]]. There are 3 groups of Elementals in the first plain and another group or two scattered along the eastern edge of the area, between large heket mobs. Again, if needed, a bounty is available, but inconvenient to reach. ====[[Turai's Procession]]==== Enter from Command Post and hug the eastern wall to the far northeastern section, where a number of groups are congregated. ==Collectors== {{:Ajambo/Collector}} {{:Kehtu/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|20th June 2011 and 25th June 2012|Bahdok Caverns|1 [[Sentient Lodestone]]}} [[Category:Contains granite]]
